RCA below.

ui_bugs.issue: Switching to the Tickets (or Reports/Ads) tab from a previous *array* tab (e.g. Users, Transactions, Challenges, Ads) renders the new tab with the previous tab's stale `data` because load() awaits the next fetch without clearing state. TicketsTab iterates `tickets.map` — for user rows there is no `status`, so `<Pill label={undefined}>` triggers `label.toUpperCase()` and throws. LogBox shows an Uncaught Error page covering the entire screen. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin.tsx:302 (`<Pill label={t.status} ...>`) and /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx:101 (`{label.toUpperCase()}`). Repro: open /admin -> tap admin-tab-users -> tap admin-tab-tickets -> crash.

rca_of_issue: Bug: Admin tab switch (Users->Tickets, Transactions->Tickets, etc.) crashes with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toUpperCase')` in <Pill>. Root cause: In /app/frontend/app/admin.tsx `load()` (line 38) is triggered by `useEffect([load])` and awaits `api('/admin/tickets')`, but does NOT reset `data` before the fetch. React re-renders synchronously when `tab` changes with the OLD `data` still populated. Since both the previous (users) and next (tickets) tab-render conditions use `Array.isArray(data)`, TicketsTab is mounted with users as its `tickets` prop. Each user row has no `.status`, so `<Pill label={undefined}>` reaches `label.toUpperCase()` at ui.tsx:101 and throws, which the LogBox surfaces as an Uncaught Error overlay. Mitigation: (a) `useEffect(()=>{ setData(null); }, [tab])` OR set `data` inside load() to null at the top before the await; and (b) defensive Pill: `const safe = (label ?? '').toString().toUpperCase()`. Backend is not implicated. Repro steps in Playwright: login as admin -> goto /admin -> click admin-tab-users (renders UsersTab) -> click admin-tab-tickets -> LogBox shows the error immediately.
